addProposal(string,bytes32[]).details: Function to add a proposal that should be considered for execution

params.proposalId: Id that should identify the proposal uniquely
params.txHashes: EIP-712 hashes of the transactions that should be executed

addProposalWithNonce(string,bytes32[],ui.details: Function to add a proposal that should be considered for execution

params.nonce: Nonce that should be used when asking the question on the oracle
params.proposalId: Id that should identify the proposal uniquely
params.txHashes: EIP-712 hashes of the transactions that should be executed

buildQuestion(string,bytes32[]).details: Build the question by combining the proposalId and the hex string of the hash of the txHashes

params.proposalId: Id of the proposal that proposes to execute the transactions represented by the txHashes
params.txHashes: EIP-712 Hashes of the transactions that should be executed

params._executor: Address of the executor (e.g. a Safe)
params.bond: Minimum bond that is required for an answer to be accepted
params.cooldown: Cooldown in seconds that should be required after a oracle provided answer
params.expiration: Duration that a positive answer of the oracle is valid in seconds (or 0 if valid forever)
params.templateId: ID of the template that should be used for proposal questions (see https://github.com/realitio/realitio-dapp#structuring-and-fetching-information)
params.timeout: Timeout in seconds that should be required for the oracle

executeProposal(string,bytes32[],address.details: Executes the transactions of a proposal via the executor if accepted

params.data: Data of the transaction that should be executed
params.operation: Operation (Call or Delegatecall) of the transaction that should be executed
params.proposalId: Id that should identify the proposal uniquely
params.to: Target of the transaction that should be executed
params.txHashes: EIP-712 hashes of the transactions that should be executed
params.value: Wei value of the transaction that should be executed

executeProposalWithIndex(string,bytes32[.details: Executes the transactions of a proposal via the executor if accepted

params.data: Data of the transaction that should be executed
params.operation: Operation (Call or Delegatecall) of the transaction that should be executed
params.proposalId: Id that should identify the proposal uniquely
params.to: Target of the transaction that should be executed
params.txHashes: EIP-712 hashes of the transactions that should be executed
params.txIndex: Index of the transaction hash in txHashes. This is used as the nonce for the transaction, to make the tx hash unique
params.value: Wei value of the transaction that should be executed

generateTransactionHashData(address,uint.details: Generates the data for the module transaction hash (required for signing)

getChainId().details: Returns the chain id used by this contract.

params.proposalId: Id that should identify the proposal uniquely
params.txHashes: EIP-712 hashes of the transactions that should be executed

markProposalAsInvalidByHash(bytes32).details: Marks a question hash as invalid, preventing execution of the connected transactions

params.questionHash: Question hash calculated based on the proposal id and txHashes

params.expiration: Duration that a positive answer of the oracle is valid in seconds (or 0 if valid forever)

setQuestionCooldown(uint32).details: Sets the cooldown before an answer is usable.

params.cooldown: Cooldown in seconds that should be required after a oracle provided answer

setTemplate(uint256).details: Sets the template that should be used for future questions.

params.templateId: ID of the template that should be used for proposal questions
